U2.note: Replaced nix-store --restore with a zstd Nix binary cache (cache/nix-cache-info, cache/*.narinfo, cache/nar/*.nar.zst) imported via nix copy --from file://<cache> --no-check-sigs after verifying every file hash against the signed closure-manifest.json.

U3.note: Added environment.etc."wros/version".text = "${version}\n" in nixos/modules/base.nix and tested downgrade and equal-version refusal on a fresh install.

U4.note: Added os.statvfs free-space check before staging, removed staged/cache after store import so installed/ and previous/ retain no duplicate NARs, and deleted older generations (--delete-generations +2) and ran nix-collect-garbage once healthy.

U5.note: Added delta bundle generation (baselineToplevel / --baseline-toplevel) pruning unchanged baseline paths and made verify_closure_archives and fetch_online skip store paths already present in /nix/store.

U6.note: Declared options.wros.updates.trustDir in nixos/modules/updates.nix (defaulting to os/config/update-trust), installed mode 0444 files in /etc/wros/update-trust/ via environment.etc, and resolved store-backed symlinks in resolve_trust_anchor().

U7.note: Scoped every derivation in nixos/pkgs/* with lib.fileset.toSource so editing docs, tests, or modules does not invalidate package store paths.

U8.note: Streamed online downloads directly to disk in 64 KiB chunks while hashing, restricted PINNED_SUITES to ('wros-nixos-updates',), and documented the two-restart /system-update apply design decision in docs/NIXOS_UPDATES.md.

B1.note: Hooked wros-initrd-unlock.service before systemd-cryptsetup@wros_crypt.service to write /crypt-ramfs/passphrase in a 0700 ramfs and fall back to systemd's text prompt on wros.unlock=text, Esc, or failure.

B2.note: Migrated nixos/modules/boot.nix from the deprecated scripted initrd to boot.initrd.systemd.enable = true using extraBin, storePaths, contents, and services.

B3.note: Dropped the undefined have_grubenv guard from boot.loader.grub.extraConfig, initialized /boot/grub/grubenv in wros-install-core, and ensured wros-boot-ok.service creates /boot/grub/grubenv if missing before unsetting wros_boot_pending.

B4.note: Removed broken extraEntries referencing non-existent default-kernel/default-initrd and set boot.loader.grub.configurationName on specialisation.text-start ("WrOS (text start)") and specialisation.recovery ("WrOS recovery").

B5.note: Set boot.initrd.systemd.emergencyAccess = false and panic=10 so no unauthenticated shell is reachable in stage 1.

H1.note: Replaced quote-dependent --replace-quiet calls with quote-independent --replace-fail across all installed helpers and debian_engine.py, retired wros-name-migrate on NixOS, and verified 0 FHS matches in helpers-no-fhs.

H2.note: Rewrote nixos/scripts/wros-install-session as a self-contained NixOS supervisor without importing os/scripts/wros-install-session at runtime.

H3.note: Set networking.hostName = lib.mkDefault "" and seeded /etc/hostname via systemd.tmpfiles.rules ('f /etc/hostname') so NixOS does not overwrite the hostname written by wros-install-core.

H4.note: Added environment.pathsToLink = [ "/libexec" "/share/wros" ] in nixos/modules/base.nix so /run/current-system/sw/libexec/wros-* is linked.

H5.note: Patched grimoire with patchelf --add-rpath containing wayland, libxkbcommon, libGL, mesa, and vulkan-loader so dlopen succeeds while /proc/<pid>/exe remains grimoire.

H6.note: Split WROS_PATH_* into per-binary attribute sets (bootPathEnv, installerPathEnv, greeterPathEnv, rustPathEnv) so wros-boot, wros-installer, and wros-greeter do not depend on wros-helpers, wros-cage, or wros-prose-runtime.

H7.note: Updated suspendLockDropin in nixos/pkgs/paths.nix to /etc/systemd/system/systemd-suspend.service.d/overrides.conf (the drop-in NixOS generates for systemd-suspend.service) and verified it in nixos/tests/console-lock.nix.

S1.note: Disabled mbrolaSupport in espeak-ng (-645 MiB mbrola-voices), disabled networking.modemmanager.enable (-67 MiB libqmi/ModemManager), disabled default desktop font packs (-62 MiB noto-fonts-cjk-sans), trimmed linux-firmware/lib/firmware/intel bloat, disabled XDG sound/icon/menu generators, and documented each change in docs/NIXOS_BASE.md.

T1.note: Rewrote boot-unlock-login.nix to boot a real LUKS2-encrypted disk built with wros-install-core, unlock with a Colemak passphrase via send_chars/send_key, log in as writer and verify non-root session, and boot the WrOS (text start) specialisation.

T3.note: Rewrote keyboard-preview.nix on an encrypted disk to test the 15-second wros-keyboard-revert.timer auto-rollback, confirm Colemak with its token, reboot, and unlock the next disk prompt using Colemak keys.

T4.note: Rewrote console-lock.nix to log in on tty1, lock the writing session onto tty8 (vlock-main), verify overrides.conf, test wrong then right password with send_chars, and verify keys typed while locked never reached the editor.

T6.note: Rewrote recovery-menu.nix to boot into specialisation.recovery (wros-recovery.target), test wrong and right writer passwords on tty1, exercise offline menu choices via send_chars, and verify no shell is reachable.
